metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins by HP-00

plugins.name: prisma-schema-reviewer
plugins.description: Interactive Prisma schema review with expert guidance on native types, indexes, relations, and referential actions for PostgreSQL

plugins.name: dependency-security-gate
plugins.description: Security gate that intercepts every dependency install or external download (npm/yarn/pnpm/bun/pip/uv/poetry/cargo/gem/brew/apt/dnf/go/pod/curl/wget/aria2c/git clone/huggingface-cli) and forces a structured 11-item security review before allowing the action. Ships a PreToolUse hook + auto-discoverable skill + dependency-research subagent (with native WebFetch/WebSearch fallbacks when Context7/Exa MCPs aren't installed).

plugins.name: minimal-mono-design
plugins.description: Minimal monochrome design system — Geist Mono, light/dark/system theme via CSS custom properties with FOUC-free init, terminal-styled components. Optimized for Astro + Tailwind 4 by default; explicit guidance for Next.js (App Router), plain HTML/CSS, and any other CSS framework.
